response.justification: Bogdan exceeds the 15-year experience requirement with 20 years of progressive software engineering and currently works on AI-agent infrastructure at re:cinq. However, this position emphasizes AI STRATEGY with customer advisory and business differentiation—areas where his background demonstrates primarily technical execution. His AI expertise is recent (16 months) and infrastructure-focused, lacking demonstrated AI products or platforms. While his technical breadth is exceptional and he shows leadership through mentoring and teaching, there is no clear evidence of director-level strategic impact or the deep, established AI specialization this role requires.
strengths: Exceeds 15-year requirement with 20 years of progressive experience across web, mobile, infrastructure, and embedded systems with strong technical depth
Currently engaged in AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling at re:cinq, demonstrating hands-on recent AI expertise with MCP code generators and agentic workflows
Proven leadership and mentoring ability through Staff/Senior roles, organized technical workshops, gave talks at FOSS4G and other conferences, and set up CI/CD infrastructure
concerns: AI expertise is recent (April 2025 start) and infrastructure-focused; no demonstrated track record of building AI products or platforms with business impact
Lacks Master's degree or PhD in AI-related field; only holds BS in Computer Science and BS in Photography/Video/Image Processing—missing preferred advanced credential
Resume shows technical execution excellence but provides no evidence of strategic customer advisory, AI strategy consulting, or director-level business impact
